campaignWindow.purpose: Publish factual GCA product-operations updates around the Go China narrative, fixed-supply Base identity, live non-custodial access workflows, browser-only risk tools, verifiable market context, and transparent release boundaries.

text: GCA / Go China Access is moving from concept pages to working product operations on Base.

Live today: controlled account access, read-only GCA wallet verification, eligible 100-credit and member ledger records, reviewed service requests, delivery receipts, and ten browser-only risk and research tools.
Manual boundaries remain: 30-day GCA Member approval, the 10,000 GCA member-benefit review, BaseScan profile publication, and any future trading integration.
Base Mainnet. Fixed supply. Verify the official contract and current feature status first.
nextCopyReadyDraft.claimBoundary: Live product-operations update only; review before posting and do not add price, return, listing, audit-completion, wallet-vendor, self-service trading, or automatic token-benefit claims.

contentQueue.angle: Show the working GCA account, read-only wallet, ledger, reviewed-service, and browser-tool surface with explicit manual boundaries.
Explain controlled account access, read-only verification, eligible ledger records, and the protected 30-day manual member review.
Introduce the live browser-only risk and research workspace without suggesting exchange connectivity or automatic execution.
Publish the current Radar issue and explain its identity-pinned read-only GCA/USDT pool snapshot boundary.
Reinforce the fixed 1,000,000,000 GCA supply and disclosed owner reserve without describing reserve tokens as locked or circulating.
Explain request, manual review, follow-up, delivery, receipt, and at-most-once credit settlement as one auditable service flow.
Show that public workflows do not request seed phrases, private keys, token approvals, custody, or trading permission.
Point users to Base Mainnet, the exact GCA contract, Base USDT, and the official GCA/USDT pool while disclosing starter-depth liquidity.
Connect reviewers and users to verified source, project identity, founder profile, domain email, supply, and external-review status.
Summarize the live product surface, manual boundaries, and published evidence from this cycle without turning build progress into a market promise.
